# Pleasant Cove Design

> Midcoast Maine web design studio helping small businesses fix outdated websites, broken contact flows, and weak mobile experiences that cost them customers.

Pleasant Cove Design builds modern, conversion-focused websites and AI receptionist tools for owner-operated businesses across Maine. Based in Newcastle, ME, with focused service across Midcoast, Greater Portland, Southern Maine, Central Maine, and Down East.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of services and the studio's approach to fixing websites that lose customers.
- [What We Build](/what-we-build): Examples of websites, demos, and capabilities by industry.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Transparent pricing for websites, AI receptionist, and ongoing care.
- [AI Receptionist](/ai-receptionist): 24/7 automated phone answering for small businesses.
- [Get a Free Demo](/get-demo): Intake form for a custom demo or free website review.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles on small business web design, AI, and local SEO in Maine.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): How we handle data.
- [Terms of Service](/terms): Service terms.
